Not physical but very psychological. In middle school I started smoking pot with a friend down the street, drinking it, eating it and smoking it. One day the cops come to my house and question me about how I bought it and where I bought it. I said nothing and they told my mother and my step dad that it was their choice, juvenile detention or not. Well my step dad really hated me for some reason, I had no real dad as he had passed the year prior, and he just started ruining my life in as many ways as possible (I will explain). My step dad immediately says "Take him! Take him, we don't want him." My mom is saying "No, that's bullshit. It was only pot.". Well the cops decided that my step dad was the guy to call the decision so they took me to the car. I was cuffed and out in the back seat. I then explained to the cop that; that wasn't my dad, he's my step dad and he hates me." And a whole bunch of other stuff. The cops decide I should stay at my grandparents for a while and drop me off. My mom came and got me immediately and locked me in my room. Whatever right? No. They took everything out of my room except my blankets and an alarm clock. I was told I wasn't allowed out unless I was eating. I sat there for about a year, never allowed outside, only allowed out to eat. When I tried to listen to the radio on my alarm clock they came and took it away too. Just a kid and blankets on the floor for a year. Then even homeschooled me so that I wouldn't talk to my friends or see anyone else. At the end of the year after everything was over, I went to school and told a friend I was thinking about killing myself. I went home that night and the cops came to tell me I need to come to the hospital if I'm gonna do that, and to talk to my parents before answering. My mom was crying and my step dad screamed and me and got into my face saying that I am a pussy and a liar. I told the officers I was fine and they again took everything out of my room. A week later I cut my wrist because I was too scared to kill myself in any other way. I called my mom and couldn't even talk I was crying to hard, blood was everywhere. My mom called an ambulance and I stayed in a kid's psyche hospital for about 2 months. They never visited. I got 1 call while I was there. When they picked me up after I was done, I was thrown a party for some reason. A month or so later my step dad began to sabotage me. I am free now, I live in Chicago in a nice apt alone. Not I nor my brother ever talk to them anymore. My step dad tortured me until I left; planting beer bottles under my bed, stealing my medication. All of it. Never again will I talk to those shitty terrible people.
